generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can satisfy focused checks yet remain non-releasable when a canonical repository gate is omitted before freeze.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Freeze after targeted syntax and behavior checks while assuming canonical repository gates will be equivalent.

reusable_control.procedure: Run or observe every applicable canonical repository gate against the final material candidate and block ready state on candidate-caused failure.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: A ready handoff must not be published until applicable canonical repository gates are bound to the final material candidate.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Independent audit must attribute any canonical gate failure to candidate-changed paths before approving release.

transfer_cases.evidence: Any candidate-caused canonical build or schema gate remains blocking.
